title: A URL shortener run by one person
text: 1 person, one week to launch. 4000 requests per second, 95% reads. The database cannot keep up now, and more than 10% of requests fail. Error rate ≤ 1% and p99 ≤ 200 ms for the whole run, at most $2,800 a month, at most 6 complexity points: one person cannot look after read replicas.
hint: Read replicas are the obvious fix, but they cost 1 more point and more money. Remove the replica and move the primary to a larger size (here: raise the number of queries it handles at the same time; the price goes up with it): the cache already takes most reads, so the primary only needs to take the misses.
